reason: This plugin is primarily a memory/context management utility for DeepSeek Harness: it provides tools to set up and update long-lived preferences, conventions, lessons, and knowledge entries, then inject relevant items back into sessions. Evidence shows local storage in workspace memory files, changelog-backed changes, snapshots, import/export, and troubleshooting/retrieval flows, so its core purpose is preserving and reusing agent-facing context rather than editing files directly, generating code, or browsing web content.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地可审计的记忆与知识库功能，可记录偏好、项目约定与错误经验，并支持按会话复用上下文。
summaries.en: This plugin provides a local, auditable memory and knowledge layer for DeepSeek Harness, helping users store preferences, conventions, and lessons for reuse across sessions.

capabilities: Reads and writes persisted memory/knowledge data under the workspace
Maintains changelog and backup artifacts for memory updates
Optionally invokes an external embeddings endpoint for semantic knowledge search

reasons.code: README states memory is stored as plain JSON in <workspace>/.dsh-memory-setup/memory.json and that updates append to a changelog.
README lists tools for import/export, merge, snapshots, restore, and backup-related operations, indicating writable state management in workspace files.
README and config section include optional embeddingEndpoint and embeddingKey/model fields for external semantic retrieval.
